topic: A3 Scraping and discovery stack: live price path, Serper dependence, platform adapters, where a merchant registry plugs in, binding crawler rulings (code at 95cf6f86)
summary:
Delta first. Between 683f56c0 and 95cf6f86 the app/ diff touches only vision, result_gate, feedback and response code. price_service, source_router, the adapters and the render wrappers are byte-unchanged, so the scrapers_health digest still holds for the price path. Three corrections to it and to CLAUDE.md: #92 (Firecrawl rawHtml) is fixed and closed; #94 was fixed in the data (571bf910) but the GitHub issue is still OPEN, and CLAUDE.md:776-780 still calls those rows wrong; #93 (sephora.me re-test) is open.

Live price path, in order: L1 Redis cache; L2 product_prices; a speculative prefetch of 4 Serper site: discovery queries; $0 direct adapters (Shopify, Algolia, bolo/boutiqaat sitemap, nasser, woo, salla, occ, magento, unbxd, rest_json, noon, gcc Shopify), where a genuine hit ends the search early; Tier 1 Serper Shopping (gl=us, parked as converted_usd); Tier 1.5 discovery plus a curl wave, then a render wave (Firecrawl/Scrape.do, render-only rows only), sharing a 12 s budget; Tier 2 GPT on organic results; a broader search; the parked converted price; Tier 3 GPT estimate. All of it sits under a 15 s outer race that is read at import.

Serper feeds about 15 call sites: price discovery, shopping, ratings (via cached shopping items), the unified specs/reviews search, reviews, images and supplements. Cutting it leaves only the $0 adapters (76 of 275 live registry rows have a mechanism) plus cache. The other 199 blank-mechanism rows become unreachable.

Registry fit: host knowledge today is a frozen Source dataclass, assembled once at import from literal rows plus data/bh_gcc_sources.json. The catalog loader drops locale_paths, discovery templates and pdp_url_pattern. There is no persistent record of per-host success, failure, robots state or challenges seen: provider attempts are request-scoped only.

Rulings. Robots fail-closed is enforced only in the off-clock sitemap builder and the search-descriptor probe. It is not enforced in fetch_page_price, the adapters or URL mode, and every runtime fetcher impersonates Chrome. "Challenge = stop" conflicts with the shipped Scrape.do ("anti-bot bypass", super mode) and the Zyte sephora.me seed. A new discovery loop must not reuse either for walled hosts. The Fragrantica/Parfumo deny list lives only in search_descriptor_service. fragrantica.com is still a literal registry row and is included in the global site: discovery query (Serper credit spent, though its URLs are filtered out before any curl). URL mode has no deny list. FragranceX stays rejected (R-A11).

findings.claim: The price path is unchanged since the S80 digest. The 683f56c0..95cf6f86 app/ diff touches only vision/result_gate/feedback/response code; structured_comparison_service gains only 41 lines (vision identity fields). The scrapers_health digest stands for the price path.
evidence: git diff --stat 683f56c0 95cf6f86 -- app/ : 12 files, no price_service/source_router/adapter files

findings.claim: Live price tiers, in order: L1 cache (:6763) -> L2 DB (:6772-6778) -> speculative 4-query Serper discovery prefetch (:7039-7070) -> $0 adapter prefetch (:7092-7280) with genuine short-circuit (:7518) -> Tier 1 Serper Shopping (:7543-7580) -> Tier 1.5: Shopify discovery (:7735), Algolia (:7855), bolo/nasser (:7945), discovery gather (:7956-8070), harvest (:8077, :8121), curl then render wave (:8259-8300) -> Tier 2 GPT organic (:8374) -> broader search (:8671) -> parked converted_usd (:8696) -> Tier 3 GPT estimate (:8727).

Timeouts: the outer race is _PRICE_RACE_TIMEOUT = 15 s, read at import and applied as _PHASE1_TIMEOUTS['price']. The curl and render waves share FAN_OUT_BUDGET_SECONDS = 12 s (read live), clipped to the race deadline. Firecrawl (30 s) and Scrape.do (15 s) still exceed that budget.

Cost and capture: curl and the platform adapters cost $0. Budgets: Firecrawl 450 lifetime, Scrape.do 900/month, Serper 2200 lifetime (accounting), Serper Images 500/day, Bright Data 4500/month. Measured capture: curl_cffi prices 84% of 94 Gulf fragrance sources; bake-off on 9 targets: curl 4, Scrape.do 4, Firecrawl 0 (before #92); UCP JSON gives the correct currency on 32/32; the 15 s race missed 23 of 30 in S78.

The render wave fires only for registry rows marked is_render_only, capped at the first N domains. Every other walled host gets curl only. No live catalog row is render-only: the literals megamart.bh, alosra, noon.com and sephora.me (requires_super) are.

Serper call sites: unified search feeding specs, reviews and image Tier 1.5b (:5878/:5887); spec search (:6518); smart fallback (:8882); discovery (:7062-7070, :7999-8005); electronics backfill (:3162); shopping (:7566/:7579), whose cached items also feed ratings; organic (:8538); broader (:8680); supplements (:8444-8445); reviews (review_service.py:701, 828, 932); images (image_service.py:258); pharmacy (price_service.py:16761).
evidence: grep of search_web/search_product_prices/search_images call sites in app/services
rating_service.py:271-276 uses the shopping query cleaner

findings.claim: When Serper is cut or the budget gate trips, search_web returns {'organic': [], 'error'} or falls back to Bright Data (dead on a 401 per the digest). Setting SERPER_LIFETIME_LIMIT darkens all six entry points. The likely effects: specs and reviews lose their grounding; images fall back to GPT Tier 3; discovery-only rows get no PDP URL; the converted_usd shopping park and shopping-based ratings disappear.

Live registry mix (ENABLE_BH_GCC_CATALOG_SOURCES ON): 368 rows, 275 live. Live mechanisms: blank 199, shopify 33, woo_store_json 30, salla_api 4, magento_graphql 3, algolia 3, occ_rest 2, rest_json 1, unbxd 0. 95 rows carry a search descriptor.

Adapters by platform, for a platform->adapter map. Shopify products.json: price_service.py:15147/15560 (+ gcc rows via source_router.py:884). UCP/PDP JSON: shopify_pdp_service.py:977/550 (flags :683/:146). WooCommerce Store API: woocommerce_service.py:302. Salla: salla_service.py:184, slug resolve :409 (flag :364). Magento/Adobe GraphQL: magento_graphql_service.py:981, url_key :1226 and jomashop :1411 (flag :213). Algolia: algolia_service.py:747. Hybris OCC: occ_service.py:257. Unbxd: unbxd_service.py:216. REST JSON: rest_json_service.py:501. noon: noon_service.py:474. nasser: price_service.py:16180. bolo: :15788. boutiqaat: :15902. Generic: fetch_page_price :14888.
evidence: grep of entry-point defs in app/services/*_service.py and price_service.py

findings.claim: Zid has no price adapter. platform_router detects zid and salla, but detect_platform has only two consumers: the og sale-price-first rule and the Salla slug check. The platform -> adapter mapping today is the registry's hand-set mechanism string, not detection.

Host knowledge is a frozen Source dataclass in SOURCE_REGISTRY, built once at import. The catalog loader maps only domain, tier, categories, weight, the is_* flags, currency, mechanism, sample_url, status, priority_rank and search, so locale_paths, subdomain_patterns, discovery_query_templates and pdp_url_pattern exist only on literal rows. Longest-host match is a dark flag, and score_source/is_render_only_domain still use their own first-match scans.

There is no persistent per-host health memory. _record_provider_attempt appends status, outcome (cf_block, timeout, no_price), detected_cf and elapsed time to a request-scoped ContextVar only. Breakers are per provider, not per host. The sitemap index is a Redis cache with a 24 h TTL, built only for bolo.bh and boutiqaat behind ENABLE_SITEMAP_INDEX (OFF).

Each search descriptor record holds only kind, url_template, robots_allowed, discovered_via and resolved_at (no robots fetched_at/status, no last success, no challenge). At runtime it is used only to build a clickable retailer search link (build_retailer_url), never to fetch.

Robots fail-closed is enforced only off-clock: in the sitemap builder (named QarenBot UA; unreadable means skip) and in probe_search_descriptor (RobotsUnreadableError). The live fetchers (fetch_page_price, every adapter, URL mode) read no robots.txt and all present as Chrome (impersonate='chrome' in 12 modules).

Shipped tools conflict with the 'challenge = stop' ruling. Scrape.do describes itself as 'residential proxies and anti-bot bypass' and has a SCRAPEDO_SUPER mode. The Zyte seed exists to render the Akamai-walled sephora.me. Wall detection exists (cf_chl_opt / 'Just a moment' signatures), but nothing records a challenged host or stops later escalation.

The Fragrantica/Parfumo ban is enforced only by search_descriptor_service DENY_HOSTS and two scripts. fragrantica.com is still a literal global registry row (usage 'price'), so the global 'authorized' site: discovery query includes it and spends Serper credit. Its URLs are not curled from that tier (weight 1.0 < 1.5 and not on the luxury whitelist). URL mode has no deny list.

FragranceX (R-A11): Option A, a catalog crawl, is rejected. robots.txt, the sitemap and a PDP all answered 403 cf-mitigated: challenge on 2026-10-19, and the fail-closed ruling skips the host. Option C (warm list + spec spine) is the D1 plan; Option B (CJ feed) is an owner/legal track.

Follow-ups at 95cf6f86: #92 is CLOSED 2026-09-02 and fixed in code (rawHtml, default ON). #94's data fix landed in 571bf910 (matalanme and xcite are now live with render-only False; bfab and letoile have new sample URLs), but the issue is still OPEN and CLAUDE.md:776-780 is stale. #93 (sephora.me curl re-test) is OPEN and would mean impersonated fetches against an Akamai-walled host.

The L2 product store is not a durable knowledge base. product_prices rows expire after 1 day (converted) or 7 days (genuine), specs after 30 days, reviews after 14 days. save_* stamps source='gpt' (per fragrancex digest). The spec spine is a local JSON that ships empty behind ENABLE_SPEC_SPINE.

recommendations: Build the merchant registry as a persistent per-host table (Supabase), seeded from data/bh_gcc_sources.json and read per call. Keep the literal rows and the frozen Source as the flag-OFF path, because SOURCE_REGISTRY is built at import (source_router.py:532). Fields: host, apex, tier, country, currency, platform (platform_router label), mechanism/adapter, sample_url, search_template (+ robots_allowed), sitemap_url, robots_status, robots_body_hash, robots_fetched_at, challenge_seen_at and type, last_success_at, last_failure_at and status, success/attempt counters, deny flag, and notes.

Feed host health from the existing request-scoped _record_provider_attempt data (structured_comparison_service.py:141-169) with a fire-and-forget writer behind a new dark flag. Today cf_block and timeout outcomes are discarded at the end of each request.

Classify the 199 blank-mechanism live rows off-clock by running detect_platform over cached sample HTML, then assign woo, salla or shopify adapters. Each promoted row moves from Serper site: discovery to a $0 direct adapter, which is the main lever for spending less on Serper.

Put one shared robots gate in front of every new fetch the discovery loop makes. Reuse sitemap_discovery_service._robots_policy semantics (404/410 = allow, any other non-2xx/timeout = skip), cache the result in the registry row, and re-read weekly with the named QarenBot UA, per the ruling's Option A + C rider.

Make 'challenge = stop' a host state. When classify_capture or a 403 cf-mitigated response sees a wall, set challenge_seen_at and keep that host out of the render wave, Scrape.do, Zyte and Firecrawl until a scheduled named-UA re-check passes. Ask the owner to retire SCRAPEDO_SUPER and the Zyte sephora.me seed for the new loop.

Move DENY_HOSTS (fragrantica.com, parfumo.com) into one shared module. Apply it in source_router (drop the fragrantica.com literal at source_router.py:347 or set it to usage 'none', which also stops the wasted Serper site: credit), in URL mode, and in any new discovery or KB ingest.

Have the KB store the resolved PDP URL per (host, product identity) with its last verified price, so a repeat compare can skip all four Serper discovery queries and curl the known PDP directly. That makes discovery a miss-only path.

Keep the URL path on plain httpx (no impersonation, per the ruling). Add a registry lookup so a pasted URL on a denied, challenged or robots-unreadable host returns a coded refusal instead of a fetch. The client already handles INSUFFICIENT_DATA and CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE.

Before cutting Serper spend, decide which legs get replaced by what: specs and reviews grounding (unified search), images (Tier 1/1.5b), shopping-based ratings, and discovery. Without Serper, the only price sources are the $0 adapters (76 live rows) and the cache.

Housekeeping: close GitHub #94 (fixed in 571bf910) and correct CLAUDE.md:776-780. Re-scope #93 to a single named-UA robots/PDP read, or close it as won't-do under 'challenge = stop', because sephora.me is Akamai-walled.

Record per-host search templates with robots_allowed AND robots_fetched_at in the registry. Today's descriptor has only resolved_at (search_descriptor_service.py:123-152), so its robots verdict cannot be aged out.

Carry the digest's breaker fixes into the registry design: per-host failure on 401/402, and recording on CancelledError (digest R7). The render timeouts (30 s / 15 s) still exceed the 12 s budget at 95cf6f86.
open_questions: Production values of ENABLE_SITEMAP_INDEX, ENABLE_SEARCH_DESCRIPTOR, ENABLE_LONGEST_HOST_MATCH, ENABLE_UCP_JSON_PRICE, ENABLE_MAGENTO_GQL_ADAPTER and ENABLE_SALLA_SLUG_RESOLVE are inferred OFF from code defaults. They need a names-only owner check.

Does the owner accept extending 'challenge = stop' to retire the live Scrape.do render wave for render-only literal rows (megamart.bh, alosra, noon.com)? These are SPAs, not challenge walls, so the ruling may permit them.

May the new discovery loop's content fetches use the named QarenBot UA instead of Chrome impersonation? robots_eval.py:22-27 records that the named agent is more crawlable, but capture rates under a named UA are unmeasured.

Is the Anthropic web_search tool expected to replace Serper's site: discovery and Shopping legs? Its result shape (no structured shopping prices) and its per-search cost were not checked in this read-only pass.
Zid storefront API: is there a public products endpoint worth an adapter? Unverified; no Zid live rows were counted separately.
Is the price-warmer service running in production? CLAUDE.md:341 says ENABLE_PRICE_CACHE_WARMER is OFF but also says Bright Data is armed on the price-warmer service.
